name: Borrowix v1.4.0
body:
I have prepared a professional release note for **v1.4.0**, organizing the technical changes into high-level categories that highlight the value for both users and administrators.

### [Release Note: Borrowix v1.4.0]
---

# 🚀 Release Notes: v1.4.0

We are excited to announce the release of **v1.4.0**, a significant update focused on refining the user experience, expanding administrative capabilities, and personalizing the platform through a robust new settings architecture and theme system.

## ✨ Key Highlights

### 🛠️ New Integrated Settings Ecosystem
We've completely overhauled how Staff and Students manage their accounts.
*   **Sidebar Integration:** To improve navigation flow, Settings have been moved from the user dropdown directly into the main sidebar.
*   **Dedicated Profile & Updates:** New dedicated pages for Staff and Students, featuring tabbed interfaces for Profile Management and System Updates.
*   **Core Infrastructure:** Standardized settings logic and routing across all roles to ensure a consistent experience.

### 📊 Advanced Administrative Tools
Powerful new features for Super-Admins and School Administrators to better manage their ecosystems.
*   **Enhanced Analytics:** Updated data visualization for better school performance tracking.
*   **School & Trial Management:** New tools for Super-Admins to oversee school registrations and trial periods.
*   **Admin Dashboard v2:** Improved reporting modules and settings management for school-level administrators.

### 🎨 Visual Excellence & Personalization
A major focus on the "look and feel" of the platform.
*   **New Platform Themes:** Introduced high-quality aesthetic themes to allow for platform-wide customization.
*   **Shared Component Polish:** Significant UI enhancements to layouts, authentication pages, and shared interface elements for a premium feel.

### 🏛️ Portal Finalization
The core workflow for the Staff and Student portals is now finalized.
*   **History & Request Views:** Optimized views for tracking history and managing requests, ensuring data is clear and actionable.

---

## 🔧 Technical & Infrastructure Updates
*   **Core Stability:** Updated base hooks, type definitions, and shared infrastructure for improved developer experience.
*   **Windows Environment Fixes:** Resolved SSL verification issues specifically for GitHub updates on Windows environments.
*   **Library Improvements:** Fixed `framer-motion` import errors and optimized motion-based animations.

---

> [!TIP]
> **Pro-Tip for Administrators:** Explore the new **Analytics** tab in the Admin Dashboard to see the latest reporting visualizations.

---

### Summary of Work
- **Feature (Portal):** Finalized history and request views.
- **Feature (Admin/Super-Admin):** Expanded analytics, school management, and reporting.
- **UI/UX:** Migrated settings to sidebar; added profile/update tabs for all roles.
- **Styling:** Launched new platform themes and polished shared components.
- **Fixes:** Resolved Windows SSL issues and motion library import errors.
